name: Texture arrays (p299)
description: p299's verification scene: runtime texture arrays (buildTextureArray) next to the textures they were built from. A 4-layer KTX2 array drawn by one quad and one material, the uncompressed PNG path, a one-member array of a texture asset, layer swaps after the first upload, `ktx create --layers` files, and texture array assets (*.textureArray.json) loaded by the scene loader. Files from devTools/assetPipeline/p299ArraySpike.ts.
